name: Consistency Map
description: Shows where your timing is shaky before you start dying there, by measuring how much your clicks scatter across attempts.

show-strip.name: Show strip while playing
show-strip.description: Draws a thin bar across the top of the screen. Only the shaky parts of the level are painted, from <cy>yellow</c> to <cr>red</c>.

strip-offset.name: Strip offset from top
strip-offset.description: Pixels between the top of the screen and the strip. Raise it if the strip covers something you need to see.

panel-entries.name: Sections in the map popup
panel-entries.description: How many of the shakiest sections the <cy>Map</c> button lists.

min-attempts.name: Minimum attempts to judge
min-attempts.description: A section is ignored until you have played through it this many times. Low values make the map react quickly but report noise as danger.

risk-threshold.name: Strip threshold
risk-threshold.description: How shaky a section must be before it gets painted on the strip, from 0 (paint everything) to 1 (only the worst). Does not affect the pause panel.

track-practice.name: Track practice mode
track-practice.description: Practice runs start from checkpoints and have different timing, so they are ignored by default.
